en: Sepia-toned vintage photograph showing a small riverside town. In the foreground, a calm river with a rowboat carrying two people and a long barge or boat along the bank. On the far bank, there is a partially ruined brick building on the left and, to the right, a stone church with a tall steeple topped by a cross. A stone arch bridge crosses the river next to the church; pedestrians and a horse‑drawn cart are visible on the bridge. Modest houses and trees stand behind the church. The overall look is early‑20th‑century rural Europe.
